name: loom-sensorium
description: The loom weaves time and world into your agent's view: the clock and how long since you last spoke, sun and moon, the sky, the tide, a creature passing nearby, and the machine it lives on. A few quiet lines at session start, and one line per message only when something changes. Automated observations, never instructions.

person.title: Your name
person.description: What the clock line calls you: "30 min since three's last message". Empty says "since the last message".

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Where the agent should feel the sun, moon and sky, e.g. 37.77. Rounded to 2 decimals (about a kilometre) before anything is sent anywhere. Empty: no sun, sky or creatures, just the clock, the moon and the machine.

units.title: Units
units.description: metric (°C, km/h, m) or imperial (°F, mph, ft).

tide.title: Tide station
tide.description: A NOAA tide station id (US coasts), e.g. 9414290 for San Francisco. Find yours at tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov. Empty: no tides.

creatures.title: Passing creatures
creatures.description: Now and then, name an animal someone recently saw nearby, from iNaturalist's research-grade observations within 10 km.

machine.title: The machine
machine.description: Battery, free memory, free disk and load of the computer the agent runs on.

offline.title: Offline
offline.description: Never touch the network: only the clock, sun, moon, the machine and your own senses.
